meta_title: Happy Home Plumbing | Emergency Plumber Hull
meta_description: Happy Home Plumbing Services in Hull. Emergency plumbing, repairs, and installations available 24/7. Fast response, honest prices. Call now for same-day service.
hero_subhead: Burst pipe at 2am in Hull? We're here within the hour, any day, any time.
services_subhead: From emergency call-outs to planned maintenance and new installations, we handle every plumbing job with speed and care.

services.title: Emergency Plumbing
services.desc: Burst pipes, flooding, or failed boilers won't wait. We're out 24/7 with parts on the van. Most calls resolved same day.

services.title: Boiler Repair & Installation
services.desc: Fast diagnosis and repair of faulty boilers, or full installation of new systems. All work backed by warranty and safety certification.

services.title: Leak Detection & Repair
services.desc: Hidden leaks cost you money and damage your home. We locate the problem quickly and fix it before it gets worse.

services.title: Central Heating
services.desc: Full system installation, maintenance, and repair. Keep your heating reliable through Hull's winters with annual checks and upgrades.

services.title: Bathroom & Kitchen Plumbing
services.desc: New taps, showers, toilet installations, and pipework for kitchens and bathrooms. We work around your schedule to minimise disruption.

services.title: Drain Cleaning & Unblocking
services.desc: Blocked drains cleared fast using modern equipment. We identify the root cause and prevent future blockages.

about_pullquote: We started Happy Home because we hated seeing folk ripped off by cowboy plumbers.
about_para_1: Happy Home Plumbing has been serving Hull for over 15 years. We began as a one-man operation because our owner saw too many neighbours exploited by unreliable traders. Today, we're a tight team of Gas Safe Registered engineers who still answer the phone themselves and turn up when we say we will.
about_para_2: Our reputation is built on honesty: we quote fair prices, explain what's wrong, and never pressure you into work you don't need. Thousands of Hull families and businesses trust us with their plumbing because we treat every job — emergency or routine — as if it were our own home.
reviews_heading: What Hull Homeowners Say About Us

reviews.text: Had a nightmare burst pipe on a Sunday afternoon. Called Happy Home on the off-chance and they were round within 45 minutes. Jamie diagnosed the problem straightaway, fixed it properly, and didn't overcharge. Absolutely brilliant. Will use them again without hesitation.
reviews.author: David C.

reviews.text: Our boiler packed in during that cold spell in January. Rather than panic, we rang Happy Home and they came the next morning. New boiler fitted by end of day, came with a 10-year warranty. Friendly lads, tidy job, fair price. Can't ask for much better than that.
reviews.author: Margaret T.

reviews.text: Been using them for annual servicing now for three years. They're reliable, honest, and never try to sell you stuff you don't need. That's rare in this trade. Highly recommend if you're in Hull.
reviews.author: Steven M.
